srcPg, srcKsu, castKfupm, castOpenAlex union(byName: true)~> unionAll

tech_text = concat(trim(regexReplace(regexReplace(regexReplace(regexReplace(lower(coalesce(title, '')), `[-\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013\u2014\u2212_]+`, ' '), `\s+`, ' '), `(?<!\w)computer vision syndrome(?!\w)`, ' '), `\s+`, ' ')), ' | ', trim(regexReplace(regexReplace(regexReplace(regexReplace(lower(coalesce(iif(university == 'KSU', author_keywords, abstract), '')), `[-\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013\u2014\u2212_]+`, ' '), `\s+`, ' '), `(?<!\w)computer vision syndrome(?!\w)`, ' '), `\s+`, ' ')))) ~> recompute

recompute filter(regexMatch(tech_text, `(?<!\w)(artificial intelligence|machine learning|deep learning|neural network|neural networks|multilayer perceptron|random forest|computer vision|natural language processing|large language model|large language models|generative ai|cybersecurity|cyber security|information security|intrusion detection|cryptography|blockchain|software engineering|internet of things|iot|cloud computing|edge computing|wireless network|wireless networks|robotics|robot|robots|data mining|big data|computer science|ann modeling|ann modelling)(?!\w)`)) ~> isTech
srcKAUST2023 derive(each(match(type=='string'), $$ = iif(trim($$) == '', toString(null()), trim($$)))) ~> trimAndNull

trimAndNull derive(pub_date = case(     regexMatch({Publication Date}, `^\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}$`),     toDate({Publication Date}, 'yyyy-M-d'),     regexMatch({Publication Date}, `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T`),     toDate(left({Publication Date}, 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),     toDate(null()) ),
pub_year = iif(     regexMatch({Publication Date}, `^\d{4}($|-)`),     toInteger(left({Publication Date}, 4)),     toInteger(null()) )) ~> parseDate

keep2023 derive(dedup_key = iif(     isNull(DOI),     Handle,     concat(         DOI, '|',         coalesce(Title, ''), '|',         coalesce(Type, ''), '|',         coalesce({Publication Date}, '')     ) ),

completeness = iif(isNull(Type),0,1) + iif(isNull(Title),0,1) + iif(isNull(Authors),0,1) + iif(isNull(Journal),0,1) + iif(isNull(Publisher),0,1) + iif(isNull(DOI),0,1) + iif(isNull(Handle),0,1) + iif(isNull(Citation),0,1) + iif(isNull(Abstract),0,1) + iif(isNull({Link to License}),0,1) + iif(isNull(Status),0,1) + iif(isNull({Link to PDF}),0,1) + iif(isNull({Link to Extracted Text}),0,1)) ~> dedupPrep

scripts.text: INSERT INTO research.publications AS p (research_id, university, title, authors, publication_year, publication_date, abstract, research_field, tech_category, journal, doi, url, source, has_doi, abstract_word_count) SELECT DISTINCT ON (research_id) research_id, university, title, authors, publication_year, publication_date, abstract, research_field, tech_category, journal, doi, url, source, COALESCE(has_doi, doi IS NOT NULL), COALESCE(abstract_word_count, 0) FROM research.publications_staging ORDER BY research_id ON CONFLICT (research_id) DO UPDATE SET university = EXCLUDED.university, title = EXCLUDED.title, authors = EXCLUDED.authors, publication_year = EXCLUDED.publication_year, publication_date = EXCLUDED.publication_date, abstract = EXCLUDED.abstract, research_field = EXCLUDED.research_field, tech_category = EXCLUDED.tech_category, journal = EXCLUDED.journal, doi = EXCLUDED.doi, url = EXCLUDED.url, source = EXCLUDED.source, has_doi = EXCLUDED.has_doi, abstract_word_count = EXCLUDED.abstract_word_count, loaded_at = now();

BEGIN;

LOCK TABLE research.final_dataset_candidate IN SHARE MODE;

TRUNCATE TABLE research.final_dataset;

INSERT INTO research.final_dataset (
    research_id,
    university,
    title,
    authors,
    publication_year,
    publication_date,
    abstract,
    research_field,
    tech_category,
    journal,
    doi,
    url,
    source,
    has_doi,
    abstract_word_count
)
SELECT
    research_id,
    university,
    title,
    authors,
    publication_year,
    publication_date,
    abstract,
    research_field,
    tech_category,
    journal,
    doi,
    url,
    source,
    has_doi,
    abstract_word_count
FROM research.final_dataset_candidate;

COMMIT;

INSERT INTO research.publications AS p (research_id, university, title, authors, publication_year, publication_date, abstract, research_field, tech_category, journal, doi, url, source, has_doi, abstract_word_count) SELECT DISTINCT ON (research_id) research_id, university, title, authors, publication_year, publication_date, abstract, research_field, tech_category, journal, doi, url, source, COALESCE(has_doi, doi IS NOT NULL), COALESCE(abstract_word_count, 0) FROM research.publications_staging ORDER BY research_id ON CONFLICT (research_id) DO UPDATE SET university = EXCLUDED.university, title = EXCLUDED.title, authors = EXCLUDED.authors, publication_year = EXCLUDED.publication_year, publication_date = EXCLUDED.publication_date, abstract = EXCLUDED.abstract, research_field = EXCLUDED.research_field, tech_category = EXCLUDED.tech_category, journal = EXCLUDED.journal, doi = EXCLUDED.doi, url = EXCLUDED.url, source = EXCLUDED.source, has_doi = EXCLUDED.has_doi, abstract_word_count = EXCLUDED.abstract_word_count, loaded_at = now();
